title: Telegram transport: formatted sends + photo/document upload + gated attachments
description:
Telegram implementation of the x72 contract — internal/operator/telegram/ (+fakebot) only; do NOT touch cmd/ or the interface files.

- SendFormatted: FormatMarkdownLite → Telegram HTML (escape everything outside the markup subset; reuse the existing escaping discipline — formatted path escapes interpolated text but preserves the rendered elements).
- SendAttachment: multipart upload — sendPhoto for KindPhoto/auto-image, sendDocument otherwise; caption escaped; Gate=true attaches the standard approve/reject inline keyboard reusing the existing callback scheme so gate presses flow through the existing Events/pending machinery unchanged; the returned MessageRef must be adoptable (Adopter path) so a later consumer process can route the press.
- fakebot: multipart handling for sendPhoto/sendDocument (capture filename, caption, markup, parse_mode), so CLI tests can assert delivery without real Telegram.
- Error paths: oversized file (Telegram bot limit 50 MB — reject client-side with a clear error), missing file, unconfigured unchanged.

Test cases: HTML mapping per MarkdownLite element incl escaping of user text inside; photo vs document routing incl KindAuto; gated photo press → EventOptionPress with the attachment ref; caption escaping; stale press on resolved gated photo acked; client-side size/missing-file rejection.
Run: go test -short -count=1 ./internal/operator/...
